method: static: tools/shader_dump/match_enb.py --match-decls. Candidates are first restricted to shaders with a compatible declaration signature (identical input declarations, samplers a subset of the ENB file's), then ranked by normalised-assembly similarity. declaration_matched_pool records how many candidates survived that filter -- a pool of 1 with a high similarity is an identification, a large pool with a low one is a lead.
note: Confidence is about identification, not about anything working. Similarity is symmetric: matched instruction lines over combined length, with def/dcl excluded because that is precisely what ENB and FusionFix both edit. A similarity of 1.000 means the game shader's whole instruction body appears verbatim inside the ENB replacement file. No row has been confirmed against a running game. Supersedes the 2026-09-01 version, which was produced with a shader extractor that missed about nine blobs in ten.

presets.icenhancer-4.0: ENB resources/icenhancer40.zip -- 10 pixel + 2 vertex shader replacements

headline: Complete Edition did not rewrite the shaders these presets target; FusionFix did. Seven of the twelve shaderinput files resolve to a single stock CE shader, three of them at similarity 1.000; every entry scores lower against FusionFix than against stock. A thirteenth target, C215BE6E, is named by enbeffect.fx rather than a shaderinput file and lives in rage_postfx.fxc.
container_spread: The nine containers holding an identified target hold 191 of 1739 FusionFix shaders (11.0%), so a selective package retains 89%. Excluding deferred_lighting.fxc -- 62 shaders for two vegetation vertex shaders -- leaves 8 containers, 129 shaders, 92.6% retained. See tools/shader_dump/make_vanilla_package.py --selective.

entries.role: alpha-faded surface using the stipple texture
entries.notes: Present in both presets with different contents, which is what shows the hash names the shader being replaced rather than the replacement. Parameter block lists StippleTexture, TextureSampler, globalScalars and stencil.

UNRESOLVED. Shares its declaration signature with 2DF967C6 (s0, s10 plus ENB's s13; texcoord/texcoord1/color/vPos) and so draws the same 11-candidate pool, but matches none of them well -- best 0.345 against 2DF967C6's 0.667 on the identical pool. Most likely a variant of the same surface shader that Complete Edition compiles differently, or one that is absent here.
UNRESOLVED. Declaration signature s0, s1, s10 (plus ENB s13) narrows it to 16 candidates in the gta_spec / gta_glass_spec family; best similarity 0.375, which is a lead rather than an identification.

entries.role: normal + specular surface with detail map
entries.notes: UNRESOLVED. Declaration filtering narrows it to 6 candidates in the gta_normal_spec family, which matches its inputs (s0, s1, s2 plus tangent-frame texcoord4/5). Best similarity 0.160 -- low because this is the largest replacement in either preset (102 lines against a 63-instruction game shader), so ENB additions dominate the comparison.
